title: kamailio.org maintenance work – Dec 14, 2023
html:
On Dec 14, 2022 starting after 09:00UTC (10:00Berlin), is planned some maintenance work on kamailio.org server. It will be unavailable from time to time, hopefully not for long time.

Affected services:

  • web site
  • mailing lists
  • wiki site (alternative use the github repository: https://github.com/kamailio/kamailio-wiki)
  •  html version of modules’ documentation (text variant README is every module folder of source code git clones or on https://github.org/kamailio/kamailio/ repository)

Short notifications will be sent to mailing list when it starts and ends.

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
